backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko canister with an empty actor definition.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature requirements to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend files including pages, hooks, components, and styles.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH CSS variables for light and dark themes and applying global styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with core routes and wraps pages with theming and notification components.
frontend/src/components/DiamondIcon.tsx: Simple component rendering a styled diamond character as an icon.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggleBar.t: Bottom bar UI allowing users to toggle light/dark themes and cycle color schemes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and managing a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, with query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useColorScheme.ts: Hook managing persistent color scheme selection and applying data-color-scheme to the document.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for Internet Identity login, identity persistence, and authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder module reserved for future backend query hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Hook managing persistent light/black theme selection, migrating old values, and applying theme attributes.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS variables for light, dark, and multiple color-scheme themes.
frontend/src/lib/mgp.ts: Provides validation and error message helpers for Mgp licence IDs.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider, then mounts App.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Renders a checkout form, handles user input, and navigates to order confirmation with a generated arrival date.
frontend/src/pages/Gen4ElcOptions.tsx: Displays Gen 4 model options and validates Mgp IDs before navigating to checkout.
frontend/src/pages/Gen5Options.tsx: Shows Gen 5 preorder options and requires Mgp ID validation before proceeding to checkout.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Homepage offering navigation to Gen 4 and Gen 5 option pages with styled cards.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmation.tsx: React page showing an order confirmation card using search params for model and arrival date, with a button to return home.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, radius, shadows, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking feature requirements, notes, and pending requests for Mgp licence validation updates.
